name: Candles
description: Guidelines for traveling with candles in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Solid wax candles are fully allowed in carry-on. Gel candles are subject to 3-1-1 rules.

checkedBag.reason: Wax and gel candles are allowed in checked baggage.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring candles on a plane?

travelTips: Solid wax candles are fully allowed in carry-on. Gel candles are subject to 3-1-1 rules.

faq.question: Is candles allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Candles is allowed in carry-on luggage. Solid wax candles are fully allowed in carry-on. Gel candles are subject to 3-1-1 rules.

faq.question: Can you pack candles in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Candles is allowed in checked bags. Wax and gel candles are allowed in checked baggage.
